description: Fixed synthetic Jandal message/core/episodic examples plus queries labelled against the packaged Kiwi corpus. Synthetic facts are fictional; Kiwi documents are loaded from core/inference/src/main/assets/nz_truth_memories.json using vector_text.
split: Within each consumer, query IDs ending in 01-06 are threshold-selection examples and 07-12 are held-out examples. Kiwi uses the same split by vibe: each vibe's first three query IDs are calibration and last two are held out.
